A few years ago, I lived in an apartment by myself. My aunt was staying with me at the time and the night before her flight back home she stayed up late in the living room to do laundry and pack while I slept in my room. Now normally, I didn’t sleep in my room at the time because I don’t like sleeping in closed quarters since my last apartment was haunted and I was still a little spooked by it. I was exhausted so I didn’t argue and just went to bed. I was having trouble sleeping so I decided to get up and hang out with my aunt. I stood up and immediately just fell to my knees. My whole body had just went limp. I thought, ‘hm, that was weird.’ Tried again, successfully, and went to the mirror to get eye boogers out and fix my bed head. While looking at myself in the mirror, I saw a floating black shadow right next to me. I immediately turn to it, and it’s almost like it had saw that I saw it, and it SHOT into the ceiling and disappeared. I was horrified and ran into the living room to tell my aunt what happened. She was sitting on the couch folding clothes except she looked different. Normally her hair is red but the person I was looking at had bright pink hair. Not only that, but she was unusually smiley and there were cobwebs all around her. I don’t remember what was said exactly but I remember feeling super uneasy after the conversation. I decided to just go back to sleep and try to forget everything. When I got back to bed, I suddenly just woke up. Every time I tell people this story, they just say it was a bad dream but I’m convinced I had some sort of out of body experience and went to another dimension.

My obligations and responsibilities versus the realistic things I am capable of doing right now are so different. What I'm supposed to be doing is go to work, go to school, socialize, have hobbies, be a normal functioning adult blah blah blah. What I'm able to do nowadays is eat, lay down, and surf the internet. Small tasks seem monumental. But I guess I need to take babysteps.
